Mauricio Pochettino's first Manchester United press conference: Watch live stream on Sky Sports as new head coach faces media
Mauricio Pochettino faces the media for the first time as Manchester United head coach at 2pm on Friday; the Argentine is expected to be questioned about the leaked drone footage of his first training session; watch United take on Liverpool at Anfield this Sunday live on Sky Sports
Friday 20 November 2026 12:52, UK
Watch Mauricio Pochettino's first press conference as Manchester United head coach live on the Sky Sports app from 2pm on Friday.
The new United boss will face the media for the first time since taking charge at Old Trafford, with the press given their first opportunity to question the Argentine about his new role.
Pochettino's opening days have already been eventful, with a 12-minute video of his first training session at Carrington leaked online after being filmed by a drone.
The operator responsible has since removed the footage from YouTube and apologised to Pochettino, United and the players, admitting filming the closed session was an "error of judgement". However, the footage has continued to circulate widely across social media.
Pochettino is likely to face questions about the incident, its potential impact ahead of Sunday's trip to Liverpool and his preparations for his first game in charge.
There could also be an update on United's squad, with Harry Maguire having been withdrawn at half-time against Aston Villa with a back issue before the international break, while Luke Shaw and Marcus Rashford continue their respective returns to fitness.
Watch Liverpool vs Manchester United on Sunday November 22, live on Sky Sports Premier League from 4pm; kick-off 4.30pm.
